correctness.rationale: Exact stationary inverse images yield m(t)=q m(t/ell)+j(t). Kalle--Zeegers Theorem 1.2 and Remark 4.1 provide ac stationary probability and locally Lipschitz positive density for q ell<1. The series for F and derivative converge uniformly on compact positive t; F(ell t)=qF(t) and F' <0. The injection mass j(t)=J 2^-t/4+O(4^-t) yields the two-term expansion and, by derivative bounds, the pointwise cusp. Checker: 216 exact-rational independent reference-density preimage identities and 24 finite telescoping identities; finite checks do not prove limit results.

value.rationale: Sharp local invariant-mass and density asymptotics at the superattracting critical point resolve a natural quantitative gap between the 2021 logarithmic upper estimate and exact observable behaviour in the 2022 map. The positive periodic coefficients give two-sided sharp laws across all 0<q<1/ell, and the explicit second term isolates smooth reinjection from other branches. It concerns an established main dynamical feature, not an arbitrary finite or numerical slice.
